categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of ion exchange and adsorption resins. These are functional polymer materials used for separation, purification, concentration, and enrichment of substances. The company operates through its main subsidiary Ningbo Zhengguang Resin Co., Ltd. and serves multiple application domains including industrial water treatment, food and drinking water, nuclear industry, electronics, new energy, biomedicine, environmental protection, and hydrometallurgy.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced production technologies including polymerization processes, functional group reaction processes, and purification/refining stages. Core technologies include anion exchange resin production systems, chloromethyl ether production systems, solvent-free cation resin preparation, and specialized adsorption resin synthesis. The company employs distributed control systems (DCS) for automated production with precise material dosing, metering, and process execution to ensure consistent product quality across batches.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves over 10,000 domestic and international customers including major listed companies and large enterprises such as German BRITA, Japanese Mitsubishi Chemical, Swiss AQUIS, Sanhua Intelligent Controls, Korean BORN CHEMICAL, COFCO Group, China Petrochemical Corporation, China General Nuclear Power Group, China National Nuclear Corporation, Xiamen Tungsten Industry, American Cargill, and Yihai Kerry. Geographic markets include China, Germany, Switzerland, Russia, Italy, South Korea, USA, and Africa.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing facilities in Zhejiang Province (Hangzhou and Ningbo areas) and Hubei Province (Jingmen). The company has established sales and distribution networks across multiple countries including Germany, Switzerland, Russia, Italy, South Korea, United States, and various African nations. Domestic sales represent 75.83% of revenue while international sales account for 24.17% of revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the chemical supply chain. Upstream suppliers provide raw materials such as styrene, divinylbenzene, sulfuric acid, and methyl acrylate from the petrochemical industry. The company manufactures ion exchange and adsorption resins which are then sold directly to end-users or through trading companies and distributors in various industrial applications.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous technology innovation with R&D investment of 26.13 million yuan (4.97% of revenue) in 2023. Key strategic focuses include: developing high-capacity CO2 adsorption resins, heat-resistant resins for special environments, specialized chelating resins for new energy applications, fermentation liquid decolorization resins, rare metal extraction resins, lithium adsorption materials, and high-strength resins for nuclear applications. The company also emphasizes import substitution and expanding applications in emerging fields like biomedicine and environmental protection.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of ion exchange and adsorption resin products (99.61% of revenue), with supplementary revenue from other sources. Sales are conducted through three channels: direct sales to end-users (69.32% of revenue), sales through trading companies (17.31%), and sales through distributors/dealers (13.37%). The company operates on a 'sales-driven production' model with inventory management, and pricing is determined through negotiation and competitive bidding.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major international players including American Dow Chemical, German Lanxess, British Purolite, and Japanese Mitsubishi Chemical, which dominate the high-end market. However, the company has established itself as a leading domestic manufacturer with competitive advantages in import substitution. The company holds the position of Vice Chairman of the Ion Exchange Resin Branch of the China Membrane Industry Association and is a primary standard-setter in the industry, having participated in establishing 16 national standards and 3 industry standards.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized chemical manufacturer with total assets of 2,039.44 million yuan as of December 31, 2023 (up 10.40% from prior year). 2023 revenue was 526.20 million yuan (down 22.16% from 676.04 million yuan in 2022), with net profit attributable to shareholders of 108.79 million yuan (down 38.82% from 177.82 million yuan in 2022). The company has shown resilience with operating cash flow of 86.34 million yuan (up 12.36% year-over-year), indicating stable operational performance despite revenue decline.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) comprehensive product portfolio covering 20+ series and 400+ product types across multiple application domains; (2) advanced R&D capabilities with 81 research personnel (22.07% of workforce) including 1 PhD and 19 master's degree holders; (3) quality certifications including ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, SA8000, WQA Gold Seal, FDA registration, and various international certifications; (4) proven import substitution capabilities replacing international brands in high-end applications; (5) strong brand recognition as 'Zhengguang' brand is recognized as a Zhejiang famous trademark; and (6) technical support and after-sales service capabilities that enhance customer value and reduce environmental impact.
